# Acceptable use policy

## 1. Purpose

1.1 This policy sets out how Acme's systems may be used.

## 2. Using Acme systems

2.1 Use your own account, and never share its password.

2.2 Lock your screen. 2.3 Clear your desk at the end of the day.

2.4 Never copy customer data to a personal device.

## Personal use

Occasional personal use is allowed, as long as no customer data is involved.

## 3. Monitoring

3.1 Acme records who opens systems that hold personal data, to detect misuse. 3.2 The records are kept for 90 days.

3.3 Records are read only by the security team, and only

when misuse is suspected.
